critic_risk_flags: SEIRS adds a waning-immunity parameter that is typically weakly identifiable in a single-season window and can mimic other effects (time-varying transmission, reporting changes), increasing over-complexity risk without improving hospitalization-target alignment (still obs=I, no delay).

Fractional memory is not clearly justified by the provided series summary (single season, high peakiness but no indication of long-memory behavior). Fractional SEIR increases identifiability risk and can overfit by absorbing timing/shape errors that are more plausibly explained by an observation lag (delayed_I) for hospitalization-rate targets.
